intro: MERA here. Can you hear me? The storm last night caused severe damage across the reserve. Status report: two members of your team are injured. Two are still missing.
You are the only one still able to reach the Northern Outpost. I would have contacted emergency services already, but the outpost relay is damaged. Without that uplink, I cannot reach them.
Another storm front is moving into the valley. My field unit is running on emergency power. You need to reach the outpost and restore the uplink before the storm arrives.
I will guide you as far as I can. My terrain data is incomplete, so some decisions will be yours. Move.
scripts.decision_river: Two crossings ahead. The bridge is faster, but narrow. The rocks are slower, but give you more room. Water levels are rising. Choose.
scripts.menic_intro: The menic bridge is old and narrow, barely single-file. It should still hold.
scripts.menic_bare: Stay centred on the menic bridge.
scripts.blicket_intro: The blicket crossing is shallow, broken by exposed rocks. Watch your footing.
scripts.blicket_bare: Keep to the blicket crossing until you reach the far bank.
scripts.consequence_river_bridge: Water level rising. The rock crossing is gone. No return route.
scripts.consequence_river_ford: Bridge failure detected. That crossing is no longer available.
scripts.decision_wood: The trail divides again. The forest route is sheltered, but storm debris may slow you down. The open route is faster, but exposed to the wind. The front is getting closer. Choose.
scripts.boskot_intro: This is the boskot trail — sheltered beneath dense tree cover. Wind exposure should be lower here.
scripts.boskot_bare: Stay on the boskot trail until the trees begin to thin.
scripts.fiffin_intro: This is the fiffin trail — open and exposed to the wind. Keep moving.
scripts.fiffin_bare: Stay on the fiffin trail until you reach cover.
scripts.consequence_wood_pine: Treefall behind us. The open route is blocked.
scripts.consequence_wood_birch: Treefall behind us. The forest route is blocked.
scripts.decision_ascent: The outpost is directly above us. The ridge is shorter, but steep. The switchback is longer and easier to climb. We are running out of time. Choose.
scripts.virdex_intro: The virdex ridge is steep and direct. Expect a hard climb.
scripts.virdex_bare: Keep climbing the virdex ridge. The outpost is close.
scripts.teebu_intro: The teebu path climbs gradually through long turns. It is slower, but easier.
scripts.teebu_bare: Stay on the teebu path. Do not cut across the slope.
scripts.consequence_ascent_ridge: Rockfall below us. The switchback is closed.
scripts.consequence_ascent_switchback: Rockfall on the ridge. The direct route is closed.
outro: Northern Outpost reached. Stand by. Attempting relay restart. Uplink restored. Emergency channel is responding. Help can be contacted.
There is a problem. My local navigation cache was damaged during the uplink transfer.

Another responder is approaching from the southern trailhead. They will not have access to my route guidance. Leave them clear directions to the outpost. Describe the route you took and anything they need to know.
